run_mmd_nash_kuhn_poker: run MMD with dilated entropy to compute approximate Nash equilibrium in Kuhn poker
create_MMDDilatedEnt_solver: create an MMDDilatedEnt solver instance with a game, alpha=0, and stepsize=1
load_game_pyspiel: load a game by name using pyspiel.load_game for use with open_spiel algorithms
compute_exploitability: compute exploitability of average policies using exploitability.exploitability
update_mmd_sequences: update MMD solver sequences iteratively and monitor convergence via exploitability
